skill.name: seo-keyword-strategist
skill.description: Analyzes provided content for keyword density, search intent, related entities, semantic variations, placement opportunities, and signs of over-optimization.
skill.summary: Builds a practical keyword strategy from supplied content and topic context.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: All three static findings are false positives caused by Markdown text, inline code formatting, and a fenced example. No command execution, system reconnaissance, prompt injection, or other malicious intent appears in SKILL.md.

static_findings.snippet: - If detailed examples are required, open `resources/implementation-playbook.md`.

finding_verdicts.reason: The backticks only format a relative Markdown file path. The line contains no Ruby, shell command, executable instruction, or user-controlled command input.
The detected text is the opening delimiter of a fenced plain-text output example. Lines 69-73 contain keyword report placeholders, not executable shell or Ruby code.
The line advises against keyword stuffing as an SEO practice. It does not request system discovery, host information, credentials, or environment inspection.

content.user_title: Optimize Content with a Keyword Strategy
content.value_statement: Content can miss search intent or become overloaded with repeated keywords. This skill analyzes supplied text and produces focused semantic optimization recommendations.
actual_capabilities: Identifies primary and secondary keywords in supplied content.
Calculates keyword density percentages and usage counts.
Maps relevant entities, concepts, and semantic variations.
Assesses likely search intent from the content and topic.
Suggests keyword distribution, placement, and topical clusters.
Flags repeated terms and other signs of over-optimization.
limitations: It does not retrieve live search volumes, rankings, or competitor pages.
Competitor analysis requires the user to supply competitor content or observations.
Density ranges and semantic suggestions are heuristics that require editorial review.
The referenced implementation playbook is not included in the skill package.

use_cases.title: Refine a Draft Article
use_cases.description: Review a draft for keyword balance, relevant entities, natural variations, and over-optimization before publication.

use_cases.title: Build an Editorial Brief
use_cases.description: Turn a topic and audience goal into primary terms, supporting concepts, questions, and recommended content sections.

use_cases.title: Audit Product Page Copy
use_cases.description: Assess supplied page copy for search intent alignment, keyword placement, topical depth, and excessive repetition.

prompt_templates.title: Find Core Keywords
prompt_templates.prompt: Identify the primary keyword and five secondary keywords in this text: [content]. Explain the likely search intent.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of an existing draft

prompt_templates.title: Check Keyword Density
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze [content] for [primary keyword]. Report usage count, density, placement, repetition risks, and natural alternatives.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Semantic Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a keyword brief for [topic], [audience], and [goal]. Include entities, semantic variations, questions, clusters, and section recommendations.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Supplied Content
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare my draft with these competitor excerpts: [draft] [excerpts]. Identify entity gaps, intent differences, cluster opportunities, and prioritized revisions.

output_examples.input: Review a 1,500-word guide targeting remote team onboarding.
output: Primary keyword: remote team onboarding, used 11 times at approximately 0.73% density.
Suggested concepts: onboarding checklist, asynchronous communication, role clarity, first-week plan, and employee engagement.
Priority revision: add role clarity and first-week milestones while reducing repeated exact-match headings.

output_examples.input: Create a semantic brief for sustainable packaging aimed at small retailers.
output: Intent: commercial investigation with practical implementation needs.
Suggested clusters: material options, supplier evaluation, total cost, labeling rules, and disposal guidance.
Recommended questions: Which materials are recyclable, and how can retailers compare packaging costs?

output_examples.input: Audit product copy targeting noise-canceling headphones.
output: Primary term appears too often in short feature bullets.
Add related concepts such as battery life, microphone quality, comfort, travel, and ambient sound mode.
Use the exact term in the title and one key heading, then vary supporting language.

best_practices: Provide the full content, target audience, primary topic, and conversion goal.
Supply source material for any competitor or market comparison.
Review suggestions for accuracy, readability, brand voice, and current search data.
anti_patterns: Do not repeat exact-match keywords solely to reach a density target.
Do not treat generated semantic terms as verified search-volume data.
Do not request competitor conclusions without providing competitor evidence.

faq.question: Does this skill use live search data?
faq.answer: No. It analyzes supplied content and context without retrieving current search volumes, rankings, or search results.

faq.question: Can it calculate keyword density?
faq.answer: Yes. It can estimate usage counts and density percentages from the complete text you provide.

faq.question: What inputs produce the best analysis?
faq.answer: Provide the full draft, target topic, audience, content goal, primary keyword, and relevant competitor excerpts.

faq.question: Can it detect keyword stuffing?
faq.answer: It can flag excessive repetition and unnatural placement using heuristic guidance. An editor should confirm each recommendation.

faq.question: Can it analyze competitors?
faq.answer: Yes, when you provide competitor excerpts or structured observations. It does not fetch competitor pages.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill metadata declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
